name: Defold · resolve-and-lint
note: One zipped Defold project dropped into a project's drop/ folder is resolved and compiled — never bundled — and the diagnostics land in out/. The lane runs bob.jar (engine sha 574678c7, Defold 1.13.1) under Defold's own JDK 25 in three steps; a non-zero bob exit fails the lint step but the report is still written.

rows.label: project
rows.note: game.project at the zip root (or inside one top-level folder)

rows.label: staged
rows.note: single files have no project to compile (rules: stage)

rows.label: 1 unpack
rows.note: run.mjs unpack · title, source files by extension, declared dependencies, native extensions, parsed game.project

rows.label: 3 lint
rows.note: run.mjs lint · no bundle; bob's WARNING/ERROR/SEVERE lines counted, protobuf JVM chatter filtered and counted apart

rows.label: 4 report
rows.note: dependencies, warnings, errors, compiled resources under build/default with bytes

rows.label: lint
rows.note: report · declared + resolved dependencies · warnings · errors · resources · resource_list

rows.label: build tree
rows.note: bob's compiled output stays beside the reports (directory; not hashed by the lane)

rows.label: cites
rows.value: input sha256 · report sha256 · env-lock sha256 · template shas
rows.note: sealed in the root store by the lane

rows.label: extra
rows.value: resources · warnings · errors · dependency_count · engine_sha · bob_version · platform

rows.label: acceptance
rows.value: report names deps/warnings/errors/resources · bob exit 0 · receipt cites input, report, counts, env-lock
